historical_commentary.text: The classic 4D Write plug-in has been succeeded by 4D Write Pro, which has its own, generally richer navigation and hyperlink/anchor capabilities, making this note's specific classic-4D-Write commands obsolete for current document development, though the general concept of in-document navigation anchors remains a standard feature expectation.
related_updates: 4D Write has been succeeded by 4D Write Pro, which provides its own navigation/anchor and hyperlink capabilities using a different, more modern document model
